In our K -fat K 1 , 3 -minor, the connected subgraphs H 1 , H 2 , H 3 are singletons and the paths P i, 0 , i = 1 , 2 , 3, are shortest paths. Even more specific K -fat ( K 3 , K 1 , 3 )-minors were obtained in [1]. It was shown that if a graph G contains no ( ≥ K )-subdivision of K 3 as a geodesic subgraph and no ( ≥ 3 K )-subdivision of K 1 , 3 as a 3-quasi-geodesic subgraph, then pb ( G ) ≤ 18 K +2 (see [1] for details and definitions).
